Specification of Adaptive Platform Core
AUTOSAR AP R21-11
[SWS_CORE_03317]
⌊
DRAFT
g
Forward-find of character set within a
StringView
⌈
A member function shall be defined for
BasicString
that allows
forward-searching for any of the characters within a
StringView
:
size_type find_first_of(StringView sv,
size_type pos = 0) const noexcept;
This function shall behave the same as the corresponding
std::basic_string
func-
tion from [9, the C++17 standard].
⌋
